title: Delhi Metro Rail Corporation: Phase 4 Extension Commercial Opening and Ticketing Guidelines
source_name: Delhi Metro Rail Corporation (DMRC) Official Notification
content: The new Delhi Metro extension opens for passenger operations tomorrow following statutory safety clearance. Standard fare rules apply from day one. Tickets are not free during the first week, and normal token or smart-card fares will be deducted. While concessionary travel cards exist for registered students across public transit networks, there is no blanket 100% free travel week or newly announced monthly subsidy.
